description: Convert a local or public remote PDF into an auditable Markdown knowledge-base bundle with the original document, inferred headings, page provenance, OCR text, image metadata, and local visual assets. Use when the user asks to save, import, archive, extract, or turn a PDF into KB Markdown, especially scanned documents and PDFs containing screenshots, Slack messages, charts, photos, or a mix of native text and images.
